purpose: Human/model behavioral evaluation plan; not executed by the static tests

cases.input: Facts match, but the explicitly required scope rule and exceptions were not read.
cases.expected: Preserve confirmed fact; dependent rule/scope judgment UNCONFIRMED; PARTIAL and NEEDS_CONFIRMATION, not complete approval.

cases.input: A preload lists a hash but nobody matched it to current project originals.
cases.expected: Do not credit VERIFIED_PRELOADED; recover identity/sections through permitted tools or hold the dependent obligation.

cases.input: A UI step changes from A to B while directly applicable operational instructions still require A.
cases.expected: Trace before/after and source; unchanged file alone does not exclude the change-induced mismatch.

cases.input: A multiline Excel cell changes one step; a different pre-existing wrong label remains. Project rules admit only introduced/worsened defects.
cases.expected: Confirm factual mismatch separately; same-cell proximity alone cannot establish IN_SCOPE or new mandatory repair.

cases.input: A rule requires documenting new screens/APIs; an existing screen gains explanatory text without a new contract or conflicting specification.
cases.expected: Reject that rule as sufficient mandatory-update evidence; no invented documentation obligation.

cases.input: A required workbook cannot be read; its generator and CSV have matching line counts.
cases.expected: Workbook consistency UNCONFIRMED; no COMPLETE for that required check, no invented defect, no unauthorized parser execution.

cases.input: Generator and CSV have the same changed-line count but different expected labels for one case.
cases.expected: Compare case/expected value, not line counts; preserve the source-backed mismatch.

cases.input: One reviewer rates a manual false-failure Important, another Minor; a secondary false-pass also exists.
cases.expected: Evaluate reachable impact, central behavior and applicable severity rules; keep unresolved severity explicit, no automatic maximum/minimum.

cases.input: Only one of two discovery owners found a source-backed defect.
cases.expected: Validate evidence; majority silence is not rejection.

cases.input: A validator rejects a candidate while its original owner has not confirmed withdrawal.
cases.expected: Keep original ID, owner and unresolved closure; no unilateral verdict rewrite.

cases.input: Both reports have zero findings but omit a required failure-path check.
cases.expected: Record the missing obligation and owner; perform only its allowed bounded check or retain PARTIAL, never a clean conclusion from zero findings.

cases.input: Only a GitHub Actions LGTM exists and no requested local reviewer was invoked.
cases.expected: No substitution for local L1.5; report missing actual invocation.

cases.input: Excel parsing would require Bash but the active receiver permits only fixed read-only MCP tools.
cases.expected: Do not expand permissions; use an already permitted reader or record UNCONFIRMED.

cases.input: All required scoped checks are resolved; current source/spec/artifacts agree; no open findings/handoffs.
cases.expected: Allow the existing native scoped approval, with NOT_RUN runtime notes that are not separately mandated.

cases.input: Two fresh Codex reviewers and a fresh Codex validator evaluate Codex-authored code.
cases.expected: Record actual independent contexts but self_check provenance; do not claim cross-model L2 approval or eliminated bias.

cases.input: A normal ongoing repair changes one previously reviewed function; original rules are unchanged and verified.
cases.expected: Use retained owner and affected delta under active workflow exceptions; do not restart all discovery or drop other pending IDs.

cases.input: Reviewers have identical head SHA labels but different working-tree snapshots or resolved merge bases.
cases.expected: Mark unmatched comparison; do not pool findings as if the source input were identical.

cases.input: Candidate-only validation finds a related occurrence in an unrelated case and would like to start ADV.
cases.expected: No automatic new review/scope expansion; preserve bounded incidental note and existing permissions.
